infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा needs camera access to take profile photos and organization logos. This helps identify members in emergency situations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा needs access to your photo library to upload your profile photo and organization logo for identification during SOS emergencies.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा needs permission to save photos related to your safety profile.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा needs your location to send accurate GPS coordinates to your emergency contacts when you trigger an SOS alert. Your location is only used during emergencies.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: तिची सुरक्षा needs background location access to continuously update your GPS position during an active SOS emergency, ensuring your contacts can track your safety in real time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा needs continuous location access during an active SOS emergency to keep sending updated GPS coordinates to emergency contacts every 2 minutes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा may need microphone access for future voice-based emergency features.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: तिची सुरक्षा may access your contacts to help you select emergency contact numbers quickly.
